description: This file defines the 'Stream' class in the ZipStream namespace, implementing the PSR-7 StreamInterface. It provides functionality to handle PHP streams, including reading, writing, seeking, and metadata access, serving as a wrapper around PHP resource streams for the purpose of managing data streams within ZIP archive operations.

classes.name: Stream
classes.description: A class that wraps around PHP stream resources, providing methods for reading, writing, seeking, and retrieving stream metadata, conforming to the PSR-7 StreamInterface.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Reads all data from the stream into a string, seeking to start before reading.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the stream and releases resources.

methods.name: detach
methods.description: Detaches the underlying PHP stream resource, rendering the stream unusable.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Seeks to a specified position within the stream.

methods.name: isSeekable
methods.description: Indicates whether the stream supports seeking.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves stream metadata or specific metadata keys.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the stream if known.

methods.name: tell
methods.description: Returns the current position of the stream pointer.

methods.name: eof
methods.description: Checks if the stream has reached end-of-file.

methods.name: rewind
methods.description: Rewinds the stream to the beginning.

methods.name: isWritable
methods.description: Checks whether the stream is writable.

methods.name: isReadable
methods.description: Checks whether the stream is readable.

methods.name: getContents
methods.description: Returns remaining contents of the stream as a string.
